errors.evidence: The assistant used the python_interpreter tool to construct and print a task string intended for the search_agent, but never actually invoked the search_agent tool to perform the required web search.
errors.description: The system selected an inappropriate tool (python_interpreter) to send a task to the search_agent, instead of directly calling the search_agent. This misselection prevented the agent from retrieving real data and led to reliance on fabricated information.

errors.evidence: The assistant claimed that the source title was "El País" and that Google Translate rendered it as "the country", without any evidence from a real search or tool output.
errors.description: The assistant fabricated the source title and its translation, providing a false answer without verification. This is a classic language-only hallucination.
